later_review_audit.description: The reviewed Insomnium snapshot configures Electron autoUpdater with platform-specific URLs under archgpt.dev/insomnium. Domain ownership, historical availability, and the original-author-domain assertion remain unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; source URL configuration does not prove domain ownership, current availability, transport controls, or artifact signing.

original_evidence.text: | Insomnium | github.com/yokomohoyo/insomnium (fork of Kong/insomnia) | Y (unmodified Electron built-in `autoUpdater`, not the `electron-updater` npm package) | Check: N automatic — only triggered by `ipcMain.on('manualUpdateCheck', ...)`, i.e. user clicks "Check Now" in settings (no periodic/startup timer found in `init()`). Download: Y automatic once triggered (Squirrel `autoUpdater.checkForUpdates()` auto-downloads). Install: N automatic — user must click "Restart" in the shown dialog before `quitAndInstall()` runs. | Y — downloaded package is applied and app relaunched via `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()` | HTTPS — `UpdateURL.mac = https://archgpt.dev/insomnium/builds/check/mac`, `UpdateURL.windows = https://archgpt.dev/insomnium/updates/win` (both on a third-party domain owned by the original, now-inactive project author, not by this fork's maintainer). **Verified live 2026-08-20: `GET https://archgpt.dev/insomnium/updates/win` → HTTP 404** (domain itself resolves via Vercel, but this update path is dead). | unknown / effectively N — Electron's built-in `autoUpdater` delegates to Squirrel.Mac (macOS) and Squirrel.Windows (Windows); neither uses an app-level signed JSON manifest the way `electron-updater`/Tauri do | macOS: OS-code-signing — Squirrel.Mac requires the downloaded update bundle be signed with the same Apple code-signing identity as the running app (enforced by macOS/Squirrel.Mac, not by app code). Windows: hash-from-manifest — Squirrel.Windows fetches a `RELEASES` file listing filename+SHA1+size and compares SHA1 of the downloaded `.nupkg`; no cryptographic signature scheme is invoked by the app itself. | macOS: the running app's own Apple Developer ID certificate (OS-enforced, not app-controlled). Windows: n/a — no key, only an unsigned SHA1 hash list. | packages/insomnia/src/main/updates.ts:1 (`import { autoUpdater, ... } from 'electron'`), :34 (`getUpdateUrl` uses `UpdateURL.windows`/`UpdateURL.mac`), :61-75 (`update-downloaded` handler shows dialog, `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()` only on user click), :85-93 (`ipcMain.on('manualUpdateCheck', ...)` — only call site for `_checkForUpdates`), :100-101 (`autoUpdater.setFeedURL(...)`, `autoUpdater.checkForUpdates()`); packages/insomnia/src/common/constants.ts:130-133 (`UpdateURL` enum, `archgpt.dev` URLs) | Because this is a community fork of an abandoned project, the update feed still points at the original author's personal domain, which is not under the fork maintainer's control and is currently non-functional (404) — effectively no live auto-update path today, but the wiring/trust model is what's evaluated here. |

fields.label: has_updater
fields.value: Y (unmodified Electron built-in `autoUpdater`, not the `electron-updater` npm package)

fields.label: auto
fields.value: Check: N automatic — only triggered by `ipcMain.on('manualUpdateCheck', ...)`, i.e. user clicks "Check Now" in settings (no periodic/startup timer found in `init()`). Download: Y automatic once triggered (Squirrel `autoUpdater.checkForUpdates()` auto-downloads). Install: N automatic — user must click "Restart" in the shown dialog before `quitAndInstall()` runs.

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y — downloaded package is applied and app relaunched via `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()`

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS — `UpdateURL.mac = https://archgpt.dev/insomnium/builds/check/mac`, `UpdateURL.windows = https://archgpt.dev/insomnium/updates/win` (both on a third-party domain owned by the original, now-inactive project author, not by this fork's maintainer). **Verified live 2026-08-20: `GET https://archgpt.dev/insomnium/updates/win` → HTTP 404** (domain itself resolves via Vercel, but this update path is dead).

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: unknown / effectively N — Electron's built-in `autoUpdater` delegates to Squirrel.Mac (macOS) and Squirrel.Windows (Windows); neither uses an app-level signed JSON manifest the way `electron-updater`/Tauri do

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: macOS: OS-code-signing — Squirrel.Mac requires the downloaded update bundle be signed with the same Apple code-signing identity as the running app (enforced by macOS/Squirrel.Mac, not by app code). Windows: hash-from-manifest — Squirrel.Windows fetches a `RELEASES` file listing filename+SHA1+size and compares SHA1 of the downloaded `.nupkg`; no cryptographic signature scheme is invoked by the app itself.

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: macOS: the running app's own Apple Developer ID certificate (OS-enforced, not app-controlled). Windows: n/a — no key, only an unsigned SHA1 hash list.

fields.label: evidence
fields.value: packages/insomnia/src/main/updates.ts:1 (`import { autoUpdater, ... } from 'electron'`), :34 (`getUpdateUrl` uses `UpdateURL.windows`/`UpdateURL.mac`), :61-75 (`update-downloaded` handler shows dialog, `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()` only on user click), :85-93 (`ipcMain.on('manualUpdateCheck', ...)` — only call site for `_checkForUpdates`), :100-101 (`autoUpdater.setFeedURL(...)`, `autoUpdater.checkForUpdates()`); packages/insomnia/src/common/constants.ts:130-133 (`UpdateURL` enum, `archgpt.dev` URLs)

fields.label: notes
fields.value: Because this is a community fork of an abandoned project, the update feed still points at the original author's personal domain, which is not under the fork maintainer's control and is currently non-functional (404) — effectively no live auto-update path today, but the wiring/trust model is what's evaluated here.
